title: Publication gate and remaining uncertainty
detail: 167 entries have an approved name, venue and San Francisco geography; 79 candidates are held off the directory. Every unapproved field is blank. A listed entry is not a claim that every fact is known.

title: Dates are a fixed snapshot, not a live calendar
detail: Only approved ISO occurrences determine temporal labels relative to 18 October 2026. Yearless dates (Menorah, Cole Valley Nights, Taraval and others) are never promoted to upcoming dates. A 2027 banner does not date unrelated ancillary events; past editions are not moved forward.

title: Regional and cross-boundary programmes quarantined
detail: Frameline, SF Art Week, SF Climate Week, NEXUS, Bay Area Dance Week, SF Beer Week, the Jewish Film Festival and the full SF Marathon require SF-only components/route evidence. This is not a finding that those events do not exist.

title: Known corrections and conflicts
detail: Zoo resident day is October 7 (not a monthly first-Tuesday rule); Boo October 31 is 10am–3pm with paid admission/membership. Fiesta en el Parque is August 1. Opera Ball moved to November 12. Bhangra & Beats moved to Yerba Buena. Alemany hours, Secondhand/Muertos street extents and Jewish Film Festival year conflict remain flagged, not guessed. Nihonmachi’s 2027 venue is blank: its Japantown reference is in the prior-edition recap, not the future announcement. Oktoberfest on Front’s admission is now the official page’s explicit “FREE WITH RSVP”; its earlier blank was an unflagged omission. Alemany’s hours stay blank: SF.gov and operator Foodwise both state 7am–2pm while the older SF Environment directory (dated 03/21/2025, before the February 2026 operator changeover, and itself deferring to market websites) says 6am–3pm; the dissent is recorded, not silently resolved.

title: Independent re-verification (session 95ceac65)
detail: A second audit session re-read a risk-prioritized sample of about sixty live official pages against every registered value: all 13 newest calendar entries, every flagged row, flagship recurring events, each cadence in each category, and the future-dated rows visitors plan around. Sampled values matched their official quotations except one omission (Oktoberfest on Front admission, now populated) and one documented conflict (Alemany hours, still blank with the operator’s corroboration archived). Sunset Mercantile street-extent conflicts persist live today; Rec Park Zumba and Yerba Buena Gardens Festival pages render client-side or behind reCAPTCHA, so their live re-reads are unknowns, not contradictions. Every URL the register actually cites was live at re-read time; no cited source was found dead in this sample.

title: Concurrent research retained; Ferry Fest dead URL is historical only
detail: The f1fd3c36 audit and 99662c40 repair are preserved unchanged as candidate history, including Alemany Flea Market and Doc Stories. Newly located sources were independently re-read where possible; old field/page labels are not automatic approvals. Ferry Fest’s former https://www.ferrybuildingmarketplace.com/events/ferry-fest/ returned 404 in upstream CI run 39092990628 and is not active evidence. Its surviving SF Travel guide remains a review link; unsupported facts remain blank.

title: Evidence and coverage limitations
detail: HTTP 200, a page title, a name match, a URL year, free parking, free refreshments, and an organization's domain suffix do not establish event facts, admission or nonprofit status. Blank cells are unverified. Commercial ticketing/JS pages, neighborhood micro-events, civic and faith calendars, sports fixtures and individual arts performances need further coverage. No claim of citywide completeness or ongoing automated fact verification is made.
